visual_style: Monumental classical Carrara marble statue: heroic Marcus Aurelius as a hyper-muscular chiseled Roman warrior-philosopher sculpture with massive broad shoulders, sculpted chest pecs, complete unbroken stone arms, and draped crimson linen toga. Authentic weathered stone textures, dramatic golden chiaroscuro lighting, medium heroic torso framing, ancient Roman colonnade ruins with torch embers. Absolutely no living human flesh, no severed arms, no pedestals.
pacing: Slow, majestic, deliberate, monumental tilts and slow drifts.
